title: 第15章 他山之石，可以攻玉

content_zh:
因为两人处在一个世界，所以不受时间调节后的无信号影响，依旧可以互戳私信。
应该是在半个小时后，佐助和小樱发现了晕厥的鸣人，当时两人也同样吓了一跳，不过将鸣人脖子上的千本拔掉之后，没多久他便醒了过来！
这也和前阵子，他们遇到的那名假冒雾隐暗部的年轻忍者的手段相符。
鸣人也将之前的事情，告诉给了卡卡西……
当然，关立远被他说成是一名认识不久的朋友，现在很有可能被对方劫走了。
本来佐助对于鸣人乱认“朋友”的行为，持着质疑的态度，但是想想现在鸣人没什么事情，反而关立远被劫走了……显然关立远确实和对方不是一伙的！
“血继限界吗？”卡卡西当时还凝重的叹息了一声，佐助看到这个词，眼中也一片冷然。
而现在还动弹不得关立远，则是正被白扛着，向某个方向赶过去。
“你到底要带我去什么地方？不如放我下来，让我自己走怎么样？”关立远用唯一还能动的嘴巴说道。
这已经是关立远，不知道第多少次和白说话，这次终于有了回响。
“再不老实的话，我就把你的声带也一起封住！”白冷冷的回答道。
“咦？你身上蛮香的？”
“……”
“喂喂喂，有话好好说！我闭嘴、我闭嘴！这是我对你的承诺……”
此时被从腹部“对折”的关立远，腹部卡在白的肩膀上，两条腿在前面，上半身在白的背后……
虽然这样的姿势，不利于关立远判断，她的胸前究竟有没有什么束缚，但是面部却是一下下撞击在白的后腰上。
毕竟白的年纪虽然只比现在的关立远大一岁，但是身材却要高不少，应该比魏樱樱还高。
虽然是被绑架了，但是关立远却并不着急……
一来是因为，他已经满足于这次的收获，反正自己“穿越”也是免费的，即便真的有危险，大不了下次重新凝聚化身就是了。
二来则是因为，关立远现在并不是真正被制住！

虽然白的手法，将他的几处发力关节、还有“查克拉”中枢封住了，但是关立远本来就不是靠查克拉来战斗的！
现在他依旧能随时释放技能……
而且白显然只看出了关立远之前觉醒了“血继限界”，但是却并不知道他觉醒的“尸骨脉”的能力！
现在关立远全身的骨骼，已经完全不遵照正常人的骨骼数量与活动关节……
只要关立远想的话，可以随时把刺入体内的几根千本用骨头顶出去！
即便是现在，几根千本也已经被关立远，用骨骼卡住了……
关立远一开始也没想到，技能居然还可以使用，按说“火影世界”的能量，不应该是“查克拉”吗？
不过转念间也就明白了，“火影世界”的主流力量，是从人体内无数细胞中萃取出的“查克拉”，纯粹的内在力量……
而关立远的“职业技能”，则是借由驱使外界的“骨元素”，来发动的能力。
乍看起来，似乎与“火影世界”的规则不同，但实际上火影中也有一种使用外在能量的力量体系……
没错，那就是“仙人模式”！
吸收、使用外界的“自然能量”，在“火影世界”中不但存在，而且是十分高等的技巧，只有能够进入“仙人模式”的忍者，还有尾兽才能够使用的手段！
不过“他山之石、可以攻玉”，关立远最基础的职业技能“骨元素掌控”，在主世界仅仅是辅助自己，能够更好的操纵“骨元素”，即便是在技能变异融合之后，也仅仅只是能够利用外界的“骨元素”，缓缓提升自己的骨骼强度、进而提升身体素质而已。
在主世界的话，这个过程会非常缓慢，只是一种修炼、辅助施法的手段……
但是在“火影世界”，这却是融合仙术查克拉、开启“仙人模式”的关键！
而且关立远可以肯定，自己能够完全的控制骨元素，不会对自己造成不良影响，至于威力如何……就只能试验过才知道了。
就在这时，白已经将关立远，扛到了树林中的一个小木屋前，此时木屋门口，围着不少一眼看过去、就让人本能说出“落魄武士、家养打手”八个字的抗刀大叔们……
哦，现在关立远的视角只能看到白的腰，这八个字是企鹅转述的。

content_en:
Because the two of them are in the same world, they are not affected by the lack of signal after time adjustment and can still send each other private messages.
It must have been half an hour later that Sasuke and Sakura discovered the fainted Naruto. They were also shocked at that time, but after pulling out the Senbon from Naruto's neck, he woke up not long after!
This is also consistent with the methods of the young ninja who pretended to be Kirigakure ANBU they met a while ago.
Naruto also told Kakashi what happened before...
Of course, Guan Liyuan was said to be a friend he had known for a short time, and it was very likely that he had been kidnapped by the other party.
Originally, Sasuke was skeptical about Naruto's behavior of randomly identifying "friends", but now that Naruto has nothing to do, Guan Liyuan was kidnapped... Obviously Guan Liyuan is not the same as him!
"Is there a limit to blood succession?" Kakashi sighed solemnly at that time, and Sasuke's eyes became cold when he saw this word.
But Guan Liyuan, who was still unable to move, was being carried by Bai and rushed in a certain direction.
"Where are you going to take me? Why don't you let me down and let me go on my own?" Guan Liyuan said with the only mouth he could still move.
This was Guan Liyuan. He didn't know how many times he had spoken to Bai, but this time there was finally a response.
"If you continue to be dishonest, I will also seal your vocal cords!" Bai replied coldly.
"Eh? You smell pretty good?"
"..."
"Hey, hey, hey, if you have something to say, say it! I shut up, I shut up! This is my promise to you..."
At this time, Guan Liyuan was "folded" from his abdomen, his abdomen was stuck on Bai's shoulders, his legs were in front, and his upper body was behind Bai's back...
Although this posture was not conducive to Guan Liyuan's judgment of whether there were any restraints on her chest, her face hit Bai's lower back one after another.
After all, although Bai is only one year older than the current Guan Liyuan, he is much taller and should be taller than Wei Yingying.
Although he was kidnapped, Guan Liyuan was not in a hurry...
Firstly, he came because he was satisfied with the harvest this time. Anyway, his "travel" was free. Even if there was really danger, he could just re-condensate and incarnate next time.
Secondly, it's because Guan Liyuan is not really controlled now!
Although Bai's technique sealed several of his power-generating joints and the "Chakra" center, Guan Liyuan did not rely on chakra to fight in the first place!
Now he can still release his skills at any time...
And Bai obviously only saw that Guan Liyuan had awakened the "Blood Succession Limit" before, but he didn't know about the ability of the "Corpse Veins" he awakened!
Now the bones in Guan Liyuan's whole body no longer follow the normal number of bones and movable joints...
As long as Guan Liyuan thinks about it, he can push out the several thousand thorns that have penetrated his body at any time with his bones!
Even now, several Qianben have been stuck by Guan Liyuan with their bones...
Guan Liyuan didn't expect that the skill could still be used at first. Ordinarily, shouldn't the energy in "Naruto World" be "Chakra"?
But then I realized that the mainstream power of "Naruto World" is "Chakra" extracted from countless cells in the human body, pure inner power...
Guan Liyuan's "professional skills" are activated by driving the "bone elements" from the outside world.
At first glance, it seems that the rules of "Naruto World" are different, but in fact, Naruto also has a power system that uses external energy...
That's right, that's "Fairy Mode"!
Absorbing and using "natural energy" from the outside world not only exists in the "Naruto World", but it is also a very advanced skill. Only ninjas and tailed beasts who can enter "Sage Mode" can use it!
But "stones from other mountains can be used to attack jade", Guan Liyuan's most basic professional skills"Bone Element Control" in the main world only assists oneself to better control the "Bone Elements". Even after the skill mutation and fusion, it can only use the "Bone Elements" from the outside to slowly increase the strength of one's bones and thereby improve physical fitness.
In the main world, this process will be very slow. It is just a means of practicing and assisting in spell casting...
But in the "Naruto World", this is the key to integrating the magic chakra and opening the "Sage Mode"!
Moreover, Guan Liyuan can be sure that he can completely control the bone elements and will not have any adverse effects on himself. As for its power... he can only know it through experiments.
At this moment, Bai had already carried Guan Liyuan to a small wooden house in the woods. At this time, at the door of the wooden house, there were many knife-resistant uncles who could instinctively say "down-and-out samurai, domestic thug"...
Oh, now Guan Liyuan can only see Bai's waist from his perspective. These eight words were relayed by Penguin.
